fields.name: hook
fields.preceding_comment: Detours the function at `target` to `detour`; *original receives a pointer that calls the next hook in the function's chain, or its own code. 0 on success. Hooks stay for the session. Since SDK 13 every hook, a mod's or HellForge's own, joins one chain per function, so several mods can hook the same function: hook_ex (SDK 13) says the order, and this is hook_ex with priority 0. Call the original through `*original` every time, never a copy of it: HellForge rewrites it when another hook joins the chain after this one. Code another overlay already redirected (its jump stub in allocated memory, where MinHook finds no room) is chained: the stub's address becomes the detour, the overlay's code the original.

fields.name: set_live
fields.type: int (*)(HfMod *, HfRef, const HfField *, const HfValue *, uint32_t)
fields.preceding_comment: Changes a field in the running game (live editing): the same deferred edit as set_field, applied at once and kept for the rest of the session (renewed if the game reloads its data), with the same checks and conflict reports. The target is found by identity every time, never by address: an entity by its resource id (a vanilla one or one a mod added), or a settings table row by its id (HfProjectileSettings: a projectile type; HfDamageInfo: a damage id; HfStratagemSettings: a stratagem type; HfDifficultySettings: a level; the explosion, arc, beam and status tables: their row ids). The mod's next live edit of the same field replaces this one; value NULL undoes it, putting back the value from before it. A record other entities share is changed only with HF_LIVE_SHARED (it changes all of them, as a stats file does). Returns when the change applies (HF_APPLIES_...), or 0 refused (the mod's log says why). Nothing is saved: a live editor saves into a stats file (hellforge-stats.json).

fields.name: set_passives
fields.preceding_comment: Overrides the local player's armor passive and second passive (the helmet's slot), solo only: the game's attribute reader takes the armor passive's bonuses first, then the second's that the armor lacks. The override is kept (written again after a kit change) until both are HF_PASSIVE_KIT; with other players in, the kits' values return and it waits. Refused per slot, and said in get_passives' status: a passive whose effect needs a package (INTEGRATED EXPLOSIVES, ADRENO-DEFIBRILLATOR) unless the armor gives it, INTEGRATED EXPLOSIVES as the second. Returns 1 held (or released), 0 for an id the game has no passive for.

Keep it short; it runs every frame. Returns 1, or 0 when the game thread's update could not be hooked (modloader.log says why). Check hf->size before calling.

fields.name: load_package

Loading is per client: other players load their own. A reference set_live or a stats file writes (a donor projectile, an explosion) loads its packages itself.

A record other entities share is changed only with HF_LIVE_SHARED (it changes all of them, as a stats file does).
